name: Stand
dimensions: Depth 13.2 cm; Height 9.5 cm; Width 41.9 cm
summary: This hardwood display stand carved into large volutes was made in China in the early 20th century during the Republic (1912-1949). During this period wooden stands were still used by collectors to display their works of art, as was popular in the preceding Qing dynasty (1644-1911).

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
